rules: Team requirement One record per person or organisation inside one firm, shared by all their cases; a case reaches it through the person's resolved identity, never by matching a name or an email
Founder decision Facts belong to the person and are reused across that person's cases inside the same firm only, never across firms; the firm's and the role's permissions apply to every reuse
Team requirement Facts that belong to one application (a job offer, a case-only answer) stay on that case and are never reused as the person's value
Founder decision Household facts (marriage date, children, a shared address) are entered once and linked to both partners; each partner's personal and restricted values stay their own
Team requirement A superseded value is kept as history with its source and dates, never overwritten
Proposal Each required fact is resolved on its own: same person or organisation, same field meaning and purpose, and the right date or context; never by copying the latest case
Proposal The selected value is the current verified one: verified by a person, with a known source, and not superseded by a later verified value
Proposal A later case-open date, upload time or edit time does not by itself make a value more authoritative

Proposal A newer declared or document-read value that differs from a verified one waits as 'needs review'; it never silently replaces the verified value, and until it is resolved the forms that read that fact cannot be approved or submitted
Proposal A value correctly superseded by a later verified one is history, not a conflict

Proposal Two current values with no recorded replacement between them (for example after two records are merged) are a conflict: both are shown with their sources and a person verifies one; nothing is guessed
Proposal A question about a past date (an address at an earlier application) is answered from the value true at that date; today's value never supersedes it

Founder decision Each field's re-confirmation rule applies on every new case: identity facts are not re-asked unless a new document differs; addresses, jobs and travel are shown pre-filled with 'still true? add anything new'; the client's 'yes, still true' re-confirms the value; until it is answered, forms that read it are held at approval and submission
Team requirement Each case keeps the set of facts it was assessed and filed on; a later change to the shared record never rewrites a submitted form
Proposal Choosing among values already verified is rules, not AI; AI only proposes values read from new documents (7.3)
